title: Auto-Renew Turned Off but Subscription Renewed Anyway

raw_content.initial_message: I had turned off auto-renew last week and you still charged me today.
raw_content.context: Customer claims auto-renew was disabled before renewal but was still charged. Policy: verify account and timestamps; explain billing cutoffs if any; if system error, refund authorized; prevent future renewals; do not argue.

learning_objectives: Verify timestamps to determine refund eligibility
Stop future charges and set a clear resolution path
correct_sop_steps: Verify customer identity/account before discussing billing details
Check cancellation/auto-renew disable timestamp vs renewal cutoff time
Explain outcome clearly: if disabled before cutoff, refund; if after cutoff, explain policy and offer best option
Confirm auto-renew status is OFF now and prevent next charge
Provide refund timeline (if applicable) and next update time
common_mistakes: Arguing about what the customer did
Not confirming future charges are stopped
sticky_notes: KEY: Customer is upset because they feel tricked—trust repair matters.
TRAP: Don’t sound like you’re blaming the customer for not reading fine print.
HINT: Always confirm the next billing date is safe.

must_demonstrate: Clear resolution + prevention of future charges
bonus_points: Gives a clean summary: what happened, what you did, what happens next
Offers escalation if customer disputes cutoff policy

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will calm down if you confirm auto-renew is OFF, explain the timeline clearly, and provide a refund plan
